_about: The Reed Marches' light directions for the review renders, in palettes.json's 'directions' fields. silver_overcast and smoke_and_lantern are places_se.md §9.4 (PROPOSAL rows, PLACES_SE); heron_morning is this kit's PROPOSAL, a brighter, more saturated third direction in the World of Warcraft Classic spirit for the owner to weigh against the flat overcast. The art director decides which reach palettes.json.

silver_overcast.title: Silver Overcast
silver_overcast.pitch: Low cloud, flat silver light, fog close (200-500 m), reed gold and green in long bands, silver water mirroring the sky, black stilt timber, indigo heron banners hanging still, white herons lifting out of the reeds.

sky.clouds: one low overcast deck with soft brushed heaps and a brighter rift over the sun

mist_bands_m: lying on the water between reed bands
round the fort's waist far off

smoke_and_lantern.title: Smoke and Lantern
smoke_and_lantern.pitch: Evening: lanterns #ffb060 low over the water under a violet-grey sky, kitchen smoke lying on the water, the sun gone behind the reeds in the west.

sky.clouds: long bars lit warm from beneath toward the west

mist_bands_m: smoke and mist on the water

heron_morning.title: Heron Morning
heron_morning.pitch: The marsh in the WoW-Classic key: a clear morning after rain, sun low from the east-south-east, blue sky with big soft cumulus over the far hills, reed gold glowing, the water a bright mirror, fog only far off.

sky.clouds: two or three soft cumulus heaps over the far hills, a few low banks

mist_bands_m: thin morning mist in the far channels
